# IndiaDostiChat

IndiaDostiChat is a free anonymous India chat room where users can connect with friends online using just a nickname.

## Main Pages
- Homepage: https://www.indiadostichat.com/
- Live Chat: https://www.indiadostichat.com/chat.html
- Chat Rules: https://www.indiadostichat.com/rules.html
- Community Blog: https://www.indiadostichat.com/blog.html
- Games: https://www.indiadostichat.com/games.html
- Donate: https://www.indiadostichat.com/donate.html
